conclusions.text: All 56552 original land cells / 20060 intervals / 130 owners are accounted. Genuine source-relative authority supports 56476 cells / 129 owners; 76 originals are explicitly held. Full source, physical, historical and construction context remains.

Exact 18 territorial conflicts and 58 prior source-fitness contacts remain held. Original semantic/parent, whole-source and whole-candidate unknowns, source-vintage/legal/dry-land claims, physical licence wording and selected/emitted delivery remain open or pending.

limits: No selected ownership, cumulative ledger, emitted raster, regional certificate, deployment or accepted repair credit changes in this source-authority handoff.

Exact original scope is 56552 land cells / 20060 intervals / 130 owners, reconstructed from complete original source/physical blocks. Genuine authority supports 56476 cells / 129 owners; all 76 held originals remain. Owner 35609 is wholly held (six territorial-conflict cells). Separate 18857-cell / 123-owner physical companion is retained and uncredited.

Complete PNG ADM1/2/3 products have 22/87/326 actual original features, 5359467 decoded bytes, 2019 represented-year claims, January 2023 update and December 2023 build, explicit OGC CRS84 and CC BY 3.0 IGO notices. NSO/OCHA ROAP simplified originals remain distinct from advertised unsimplified products. The complete IDN ADM1 foreign product has 34 features / 3397843 bytes, 2017 represented-year claim, OSM/Wambacher provenance and ODbL 1.0 terms. No source clipping, geometry repair or reprojection is introduced.

All 130 direct original local-government-area roles and complete parents remain. No aggregate intent or recorded name/role corrections are invented. All selected semantic followup stays open. Rural/urban and district-cluster roles, Tawae/Siassi split across New Guinea/Bismarck, and Kimbe/Kerema/Balimo missing-cell, land-loss and weak-parent-overlap questions are preserved.

Complete catalogue membership is derived from all 368 products / 73567 actual features and current ancestry; 7027 foreign ownerless original features yield nine exact census contacts. Counts are measured, not an incidental screening expectation. Complete country and foreign ADM1 negatives have fifteen identical keys; union with the nine original-source keys is eighteen. All are held. Full original negative geometry is retained, including ownerless competitors.

All 43 issue-bearing whole-physical results remain among 130 stages. Source-relative centre support does not certify full-target correctness, inland-water semantics or current dry land. Retained GSHHG data LICENSE says LGPL v3-or-later while its README says v3-or-earlier; this wording conflict remains unresolved.

All 95173 historical candidates and routing rows are reconstructed before screening. All 519 overlapping candidates covering 23450 original centres and their whole-candidate unknowns remain. Country tags do not omit competitors or determine acceptance.

Complete prior Melanesia 363 outcomes preserve 41 full cases, 69 partial source fragments, 253 held cases, 110 payloads and 69 literal nonempty remainders. Prior supported fragments and remainders have zero exact original PNG contacts. Five whole held candidates contact 58 originals: Rapatona 1, Balopa 1, Dobu 1, Morobe 46 and Tufi 9. The first 49 retain mixed-source-support/whole-source-fitness review prerequisites; Tufi retains unknown-physical/numeric-closure prerequisites. Generic source-relative/native success does not discharge them. Three invalid generalized GeoReP operands are NCL and do not impose a PNG countrywide veto.

Prior PR1639 source-relative research acceptance and issue1647 old-polygon closure preserve old holds and remainders while directing current-cell work. Approval of original full cases 011/034/035 is retained, but their historical diagnostic does not prove current gain. All 58 prior contacts remain held separately from the 18 territorial conflicts.

Actual original diagnostic at its immutable input pin supports 56534 and holds 18. The final supported writer subtracts the exact 58 disjoint prior holds. It authenticates compact source bytes and original source, stage, latitude and complete negative operands; checks all unchanged positive fields; independently proves every omitted negative disjoint from the whole original, whole selected target and every original mask interval. Seven exact whole operands remain from 390; 383 disjoint copies are removed. Original evidence shrinks from 80520632 to 2585364 bytes. Original diagnostic pins remain literal and reachable, with complete original operands retained once in the current packet.

The copied custom writer 64-MiB ceiling caused an actual pre-output failure, retained here. Unexplained custom file/phase/time ceilings are removed separately from compaction; exact Git size/hash identities, completeness and destination refusal controls remain. Original producer outputs retain their original executed-code and allowance history. Current code does not claim removed ceilings remain active. Stock cooperative execution allowances are separate and no hard process containment is claimed.

The genuine stock constructor qualifies the exact 56476 supported keys. Strengthened supported-writer outputs are byte-identical to its actual source/patch inputs; no diagnostic or scientific producer was replayed. Sixteen actual occupied/dangling-symlink refusals cover eight custom writers. No whole-application or emitted-consumer test is claimed. Current accepted overlap, selected owner-zero and final emitted conservation remain delivery obligations.
